method_notes: FIXTURE FOR TESTS. Every business in this file is made up. No page was opened. Everything comes from search-result text.

qualified.restaurant: Sample Sushi House (also listed as Sample Sushi)
qualified.independent_evidence: One address in every listing and no parent brand seen.

observations.evidence: Two searches returned only directory pages. No domain belonging to the restaurant appeared.
One listing shows 11 to 9 and another shows 11 to 10.

qualified.strengths: Takes pickup orders through a delivery app and has many reviews.
qualified.suggested_improvement: A one-page site with current hours, phone, a map and a readable menu.
qualified.package_reason: No site exists, and the main need is one page the restaurant controls.
qualified.fit_reason: No own website in two searches and good evidence it is open.
qualified.personal_opening: I'm a college student who has worked in restaurants, and I build simple websites for independent restaurants. When I looked up Sample Sushi House I found your listings on a delivery app, but I couldn't find a website of your own. Would it help to have one page you control with your hours and menu?
qualified.verify_before_outreach: On your own phone, search for the restaurant and look for a website button. Confirm the restaurant is open and that (785) 555-0111 is right. The phone number comes from a directory.

qualified.independent_evidence: A single location on its own domain.

observations.issue: Menus are published as PDF files
observations.evidence: A search restricted to the domain returned two menu PDFs and no page listing dishes as text.

observations.issue: Catering is arranged by phone only
observations.evidence: The site mentions private parties but no request form appeared in the indexed text.

qualified.strengths: Has its own domain with address, phone and hours on the home page.
qualified.suggested_improvement: Turn the PDF menus into phone-readable text and add a short catering request form.
qualified.package_reason: Several menus and regular party bookings suit a few pages plus a request form.
qualified.fit_reason: Top-priority cuisine with two concrete, checkable issues.
qualified.personal_opening: I've worked in restaurants and now build simple websites for independent ones. On your site I noticed that the menus are PDF files, which are hard to read on a phone. If it would be useful, I could show you what the same menus look like as normal web pages.
qualified.verify_before_outreach: Open sample-hibachi.example.com on your phone. Confirm the menus still open as PDFs; check whether the site has a catering form; compare the hours on each page.

qualified.independent_evidence: One address. A reviewer describes it as family run.

observations.issue: Online ordering is advertised but appears not to be live
observations.evidence: The home page offers an order button while the order page says that online ordering is coming soon.

qualified.strengths: Its own domain already covers address, phone, hours and a text menu.
qualified.suggested_improvement: Switch the ordering page on, or change the button to a call link. A full rebuild is probably not needed.
qualified.package_reason: The smallest package is the only one that could apply, and it is probably more than they need.
qualified.fit_reason: Thin evidence: one search only, and the site otherwise does its job.
qualified.personal_opening: I'm a college student who has worked in restaurants, and I build websites for independent restaurants. On your website the home page has an order button, but the order page says online ordering is coming soon. I wanted to mention it in case you weren't aware.
qualified.verify_before_outreach: Open the site on your phone and tap the order button. If ordering works, drop this record.

site already good, as far as search shows: hours and a menu were visible.
